caption: The drawing depicts a large, ornate, lidded vessel or urn rendered in grayscale pencil on off-white paper. The vessel has a symmetrical design with two large handles, each curving outward in a spiral pattern. The round body of the urn features a series of vertically oriented, oval-shaped segments that give it a ribbed appearance. The lid of the urn has a rounded dome with scalloped segments and is topped by a finial with a small round knob and a flat circular element beneath it. Decorative floral or leaf patterns embellish both the band near the top of the urn and the base, encircling the vessel. The urn sits on a wide, rounded pedestal that supports its weight. Shading is used to suggest a metallic surface and to give the object a three-dimensional look. In the lower right corner of the paper, the name "Nicholas Zyspa" is inscribed.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
